x: Syd Jones, our weight putter, also arrived in the Middle East, with one stripe up. Dennis Rodaway, we understand, has been commissioned in the Fleet Air Arm. Joe Flower, posted as an Observer in the R.A.F.

Dennis Rodaway, now a Lieutenant, R.A.N.S., and looking remarkably well, came along to the first meeting at Tooting in May. Dick Norton, our very promising junior sprinter, is suffering from acute synovitis, sustained whilst playing football, and has been ordered not to run again for some months.
Is hoping to meet any other Bels. in the 8th. Dennis Rodaway has recently been awarded the South Africa Star. Details are not known, meanwhile congratulations.
Dennis Rodaway was recently seen round the S.W.11 district by our old friend Charlie Cook. "Sailor" Johnson recently visited the Hall for a run when on leave.
